verdict.rationale: The story's axis applies: an immigration-petition provider could publish how AI is used in drafting and review and where attorneys check the work. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI at all, nor any automated-versus-attorney review split. The products page covers narrative strategy, evidence packaging, support, pricing and security, but not AI use or human-review division. The 'attorney' mention in docs-7 is about People Ops coordination, not an AI/human review disclosure.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider states how it uses AI in petition drafting and review — what is automated, what a human attorney checks — on its own pages
